params.name: comments
params.description: Comments to be added to the file

params.name: parentFileId
params.description: Creates a new version for the specified parent file id

params.name: folderId
params.description: The id of the folder to upload the file within

params.name: conflictResolution
params.description:
Defines behaviour for when a file conflict is found

Options:

  • Replace
  • KeepBoth
  • SaveVersion
  • Skip

items.docs:
Add or update a file in a contract. \
 \
The body of the request must be content-type 'multipart/form-data' and contain the file data. \
 \
To update the contract document: Only specify the 'parentFileId' parameter. The 'folderId' and 'conflictResolution' parameters should not be used for these updates
